Supply of Disinfect for Silk Worm Raring for

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Deputy director of Sericulture, Zilla Panchayath Bengaluru South District, B.M Road, Ramanagara

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Company Registration certificate or Establishment Registration Certificate of the Bidder,GST Registration Certificate with the details of remittance of GST for the Quarter ending March-2025 as downloaded from the GST Portal,Proof of experience of with minimum two years experience in manufacturing and supply of such Scheduled Goods or similar products to the Govt depts

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Experience as mentioned in qualification criteria in tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the product/s (s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements upto at least 80 percentge (40percentge in case of Karnataka based MSE Manufacturers ) of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 (2 years 2023-24, 2024-25) in case of Karnataka based MSE Manufacturers). The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance for both (a) and (b) above, in proforma under Section XIV-CAPABILITY STATEMENT PARA 4.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should furnish details of Supply Centres and information on Supply facilities within the district/s jurisdiction of the Package for which the tender is submitted in the Form given in Section SECTION XIV-CAPABILITY STATEMENT PARA 7, 8 and 9

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be as indicated under SECTION V: SCHEDULE OF REQUIREMENTS (usually not less than the estimated cost of the quantity in the Tender document it will be 50% of the estimated cost of the quantity with respect to Micro & Small enterprises) during the last 3 preceding financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 (last 2 preceding financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises. The tenderer should furnish the information on Financial Turnover in proforma under Section XIV-CAPABILITY STATEMENT PARA 5

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderers quoting as authorized representative of a manufacturer, meeting with the above requirement in full, can also be considered provided. the manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations the tenderer, as authorized representative, has supplied satisfactorily at least 30 percentage of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least 12 months on the date of tender opening.

A declaration has to be submitted in Compliance regarding restrictions on public procurements from bidders of countries which shares a Land Border with India, in the form of Affidavit as per SECTION XV- UNDERTAKING
